about: 30-day Instagram plan (9 Nov – 8 Dec 2026). One Reel a day at 20:00 Asia/Karachi; carousels at 13:00 on the days that have one. 'needs' says whether Claude can make it alone: auto = from app screenshots and graphics; footage = needs the owner's video; permission = needs a real runner's written OK; partner = needs another account. When the main idea isn't auto, make the 'fallback' instead and tell the owner what the main idea needs.
countdown: BYD Karachi Marathon is Sun 3 Jan 2027. Lakson Investment Special Olympics Pakistan Unified Marathon is Sun 29 Nov 2026 (use its name only with the organiser's OK; until then say 'this month's race').
